suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single back-and-forth comment.
I'm thankful for the first call to prayer drifting in while the kitchen's still quiet.
I'm grateful for finding the typo in the config file before it ever reached the client.
I'm thankful for teh tarik poured with that perfect foam, not the sad flat kind.
I'm grateful for a laptop fan that finally stopped screaming after I closed those fifty tabs.
I'm thankful for my dad still saving me the last piece of rendang without being asked.
I'm grateful for a standup that actually finished in fifteen minutes like it's supposed to.
I'm thankful for the smell of wet tar after an afternoon downpour on the way home.
I'm grateful for a junior on the team asking a question that made me double-check my own assumptions.
I'm thankful for payday landing on a Friday, just when the fridge was looking embarrassingly empty.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that caught the bug before production ever had the chance.
I'm thankful for an aunty at the warung remembering my order without me saying a word.
I'm grateful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after weeks of sweating through meetings.
I'm thankful for a group chat that still laughs at the same old jokes from years ago.
I'm grateful for ten uninterrupted minutes to just sit and not look at a screen.
